original_text: –Treat all chemicals as if they were dangerous; do not taste, touch or smell anything.–Never assume that a clear liquid is water.–Carry reagent bottles and beakers with two hands to avoid spilling or dropping them, or use a cart when available.–Do not return unused reagent to the original container to avoid contamination.–Do not leave containers and bottles open for extended periods of time.  Close caps and lids tightly when not in use.–Always return chemicals where you found them when you are finished.
explanation: This slide sets rules for handling chemicals safely. All chemicals must be treated as dangerous; tasting, touching, or smelling them is forbidden. One must never assume a clear, colorless liquid is water. Beakers and reagent bottles should be carried using two hands to prevent drops and spills, or transported on a cart when available. To avoid contaminating stock chemicals, unused reagents must never be poured back into their original containers. Containers and bottles must not be left open for extended periods; caps and lids should be closed tightly when not in use. Finally, after finishing, chemicals must always be returned to their original designated locations.
